environment.limits: Single uncontrolled desktop host; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Cold means empty tool disk cache, not cold OS/page cache. No simultaneous benchmark suites. No production CDN, Next.js or serverless measurement.

protocol: Seven sequential upgrade trials, each uses a fresh isolated Vite root and shared on-disk caches within its four fresh Node processes: 3.1.8 cold, 3.1.8 warm, selected 3.1.9 pipeline first build without clearing caches, then selected pipeline warm. All 24 Kodak photos use ordinary imports with default multi-format settings. Image-byte/SHA multisets must match. Collect actual output filenames and cache entry counts after each build. OS caches unflushed, serial suites; this measures a version transition, not normal warm performance or cloud deployment.
